publisher: Ministry of Finance (Accountant General) via data.gov.il

terms_of_use.attribution: מקור המידע: משרד האוצר, החשב הכללי, מאגר "ריביות של פיקדונות חיסכון לכל ילד – עדכון יומי", data.gov.il (https://data.gov.il/he/datasets/mof/savingsplaninterest), לפי תנאי השימוש במאגרי המידע הממשלתיים

notes: The bank's quoted rates for the child-savings programme (nine banks). Source rows are one per date, bank, plan, age and saving period with three rates; each observation's key is "<bank>|<plan>|<age>|<saving period>|<metric>" as the file prints the first four, and the metric is one of fixed_unlinked (fixed rate, unlinked, % a year), fixed_cpi_linked (fixed CPI-linked rate, % a year) or variable_spread (variable rate, percentage points from prime, negative = below prime). The file keeps the latest 14 months (the source file is a rolling window). For each key it keeps the first value in the window, every value that differs from the one before and the latest day; a value holds until the next observation of the same key. Value dates in the source are about every second day.
